scope: Addendum only; original diagnostic.json and trajectory.npz are preserved unchanged.

recording_issue.cause: The first side-support prototype stored mutable EMA dictionaries and target lists by reference in its sample list.
unaffected_evidence: sample times, positions, actual rocker angles, contacts, velocities and actuator forces
assist_events: support_up_n and targets_deg were copied at each event
recording_issue.remediation: Do not infer historical support loads from the affected sample fields. Use independent NPZ action replay; the trigger50 rerun stores copies. Final dictionary values describe only the final observation, not earlier samples.

controller_gating_change.purpose: Permit the measured supported front wheel to start the planned negative swing. This is controller state-transition logic, not a dataset quality threshold.
